plans.prompt: A dim, empty hospital corridor at night, seen from the middle of the hallway. Warm ceiling lights switch on one by one in sequence down the corridor, pushing back the darkness. No people visible. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, slow push-in, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

First-person point of view, close-up on a hand resting on a computer mouse on a dark wooden desk. A plain gold wedding ring and a wristwatch are clearly visible on the wrist. The hand presses the mouse button once. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

Static frontal wide shot of a crowded classroom. Students sit at desks and more stand along the back wall. The front of the room, where a teacher would stand, is not visible. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

Handheld camera with slight natural movement, inside a crowded bar at night on election night. People stand shoulder to shoulder, looking up and out of frame at an old television mounted high on the wall; its screen glows bright cold blue-white, no readable text or logos on screen. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

Inside the same crowded bar, people erupt in celebration: confetti explodes and falls through the air, hands raised, phone lights glowing. No flags, no banners, no readable text anywhere in frame. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

First-person point of view, close-up on an older hand wearing a new wristwatch, resting on a computer mouse on a dark wooden desk. In the background, slightly out of focus, a computer monitor pulses with a red warning glow. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

Wide shot of large wind turbines slowly spinning against a sunrise sky, warm golden light, open landscape, no people, no logos or text visible. Cinematic, slow push-in, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

A factory gate slowly closing. One worker wearing a plain solid orange uniform stands still, watching, seen from behind or in silhouette so the face is not visible. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

A peaceful protest seen through a rain-streaked office window from above. Below, a crowd raises hands and holds plain solid orange banners with no text or symbols, no national flags anywhere. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

First-person point of view from behind a podium at night. An older hand grips the edge of the podium, a plain gold wedding ring visible on the wrist. In front, a large cheering crowd lit by phone lights fills the square; the speaker's face is not visible. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

First-person point of view from behind a podium at night, same framing as before. An aging hand grips the podium edge. A cheering crowd fills the square below, confetti falling, phone lights raised. Face not visible. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

First-person point of view from behind a podium at night, same framing as before. An even older hand grips the podium edge. A larger cheering crowd fills the square below, more confetti falling, phone lights raised. Face not visible. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

First-person point of view from behind a podium at night, same framing as before. A visibly elderly hand grips the podium edge. The largest cheering crowd yet fills the square below, dense confetti falling, countless phone lights raised. Face not visible. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

First-person point of view, close-up on elderly, slightly trembling hands resting on a dark wooden desk. The skin shows visible age spots; no wedding ring is worn. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

First-person point of view, close-up on an elderly hand slowly moving a computer mouse across a dark wooden desk in near darkness, rain visible streaking the window in the background, faint monitor glow flickering off-screen. Very slow, deliberate movement. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

First-person point of view, close-up on the same elderly hand, now still on the mouse, a faint tremor visible in the fingers, dim monitor glow on the skin. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

Extreme close-up on a single elderly finger hovering just above a mouse button, trembling slightly, monitor glow on the skin, the shot fading to black before the finger presses down. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.
